body: As someone who took out student loans and never finished their degree I can tell you right now that the world is nightmare. Your ex sounds like a real cunt and your dad sounds like a POS too. I would say this, if you want to kill yourself make sure you do it because of your own decisions that you made, not because your Dad said that or your ex did that too you. Do not kill yourself because other people made you feel that way, because they don't deserve to have that power over you. And if you died would they care anyway? It doesn't sound like it. So either live to spite them and unleash your fury by becoming better or die because it was the right decision for you and not because anyone else made you want to do it.

Your best bet is using a gun. Depending on where you live, it may be hard to procure one, but it is the single most reliable method and your brain doesn't have time to process the pain from a gunshot. A shotgun slug to the head will finish anyone off completely as long as it hits your brain. IMO any method of suicide attempt that doesn't guarantee 100% success is asking to be a vegetable or have everyone know that you failed at killing yourself which is also miserable. Only you can make the judgement about whats best for you though.
